title: Private CRM insurance contact-attempt presentation
purpose: Expose bounded read-only insurance contact-attempt history inside the existing canonical River OS CRM without activating the fail-closed insurance-contact action or any provider runtime.

readModel.identity: relationshipId remains canonical River CRM identity
readModel.perRelationshipBound: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY relationship_id ORDER BY requested_at DESC, attempt_id ASC)

presentation: show contact channel, intent, canonical lifecycle state, and requested timestamp
show provider-neutral structured failure information when an attempt is failed
do not expose provider credentials, raw provider payloads, or provider transport controls
distinguish unreadable contact-attempt history from a readable relationship with no attempts
behavior: load attempts as a bounded cohort rather than one query per CRM card
deduplicate canonical relationship IDs before binding
perform no query for an empty relationship cohort
reuse canonical InsuranceContactAttempt reconstruction for every persisted row
